column1: Ability for employees to enter their own availability and have that reflect in the system in real time
Automatic allocation of shifts to the "best" employee
Tracking and reporting mechanisms for employees that accept and reject the shifts (including reasons why shifts were declined)
Bidding or multi offer options for emergency shifts using an automated process
Tracking of service agreements including expiry dates, total funding amount, funding utilised, remaining funding etc.
Automate creation of invoices after services have been provided, through an approval process
API feeds to Xero (Finance system) for billing and revenue recognition
Ability to create Bulk Upload files for PRODA / PACE
Payroll system which adheres to SCHADS rules and regulations, including highlighting which shifts were the issue
